newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chubais says Russian govt most reformist ever.
newsitem.headline: Chubais says Russian govt most reformist ever.

text.p: Anatoly Chubais, the Russian government's economic reform chief, said the present cabinet, formed nearly three months ago, was more committed to reform than any of the teams he had served in over the past six years.

"Being for almost six years in the Russian government, I have never had such a supportive climate," Chubais, speaking in English, told a news conference on Friday. He singled out his fellow First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov and Economy Minister Yakov Urinson for particular mention.

Chubais, who also holds the post of finance minister, said the reforms being implemented by the new government would, barring extraordinary upsets, lead to Russians' first increase in living standards since the end of the Soviet Union in 1991.
